newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 1996 trade deficit widens to $20.38 bln.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 1996 trade deficit widens to $20.38 bln.

text.p: South Korea's customs-cleared trade deficit widened to $20.38 billion in calendar 1996 from $10.06 billion in 1995, provisional figures released by the trade ministry on Friday showed.
The trade deficit rose to $1.37 billion in December from $49 million a year earlier, the figures showed.
NOTE: in billions of dollars, November figures revised.
A ministry statement said FOB exports rose 3.8 percent in 1996 from 1995, while CIF imports increased 11.2 percent.
Exports of semiconductors last year fell 19.2 percent to $17.87 billion from 1995, while total exports excluding semiconductors rose 8.8 percent to $111.97 billion, it said.
At the beginning of 1996, the ministry forecast semiconductor exports would reach $30.7 billion in the year.
"Unit price for the 16 megbit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips fell 81.7 percent to $9.25 at the end of 1996 from a year earlier," the statement said.
